equation_request.abstract: Quantum parameter estimation is central to many fields such as quantum computation, communications and metrology. Optimal estimation theory has been instrumental in achieving the best accuracy in quantum parameter estimation, which is possible when we have very precise knowledge of and control over the model. However, uncertainties in key parameters underlying the system are unavoidable and may impact the quality of the estimate. We show here how quantum optical phase estimation of a squeezed state of light exhibits improvement when using a robust fixed-interval smoother designed with uncertainties explicitly introduced in parameters underlying the phase noise.

specification.problem: Estimate a hidden random-walk phase trajectory phi_1..phi_N imprinted on a truncated-Fock squeezed-light register, from discretized homodyne-like outcomes, using a fixed-interval RTS smoother whose process-noise variance is chosen robustly (minimax MSE) over an uncertain q in [q_min,q_max].
specification.reconstruction_scope: One tiny instance: a 3-qubit truncated Fock register (dimension 8, even-photon squeezed vacuum amplitudes), N~4-6 time steps, one circuit per step with a hidden phi_k, many shots per step to get a measured outcome distribution, then classical scalar Kalman filter plus RTS smoother with a robust (inflated) q. Outside scope: continuous-mode treatment, true homodyne statistics, the paper's exact robust smoother derivation and parameter uncertainty model, experimental details.

symbols.meaning: effective readout noise variance of the phase measurement (assumed known or calibrated)
squeezing parameter of the truncated state
Fock amplitudes of squeezed vacuum, truncated and renormalized
phase estimate/measurement derived from shot statistics at step k
robust design noise variance used in the smoother

equations.label: Phase random walk
equations.description: State model with uncertain diffusion variance.
equations.abstract_quote: uncertainties explicitly introduced in parameters underlying the phase noise
equations.justification: The abstract mentions phase noise with uncertain parameters; the random walk form is the assumed model.

equations.label: Phase encoding on Fock register
equations.description: Diagonal phase gate with Fock number n=sum_j 2^j b_j (qubit j is bit j, little-endian), made of P gates.
equations.justification: Proposed discretization of the phase shift; P gates on bits give exactly this diagonal.
assumptions: c_n approx squeezed vacuum: c_{2m} proportional to (-tanh xi)^m sqrt((2m)!)/(2^m m!)

equations.label: Quadrature-like readout
equations.description: Hadamard-basis rotation then computational-basis measurement gives discretized outcome y in 0..7 (bit order little-endian: last counts character is qubit 0). Per-step phase measurement y_k is derived classically, e.g. by maximum likelihood over a phi grid, with effective variance r.
equations.justification: Emulation of homodyne by basis rotation as in the sketch.
assumptions: Phase-to-outcome map is not claimed to be linear; ML grid estimate with r calibrated by simulation

equations.label: Kalman filter forward pass
equations.description: Scalar forward filter with design noise q_r.
equations.justification: Standard scalar Kalman filter for a random walk observed with noise.

equations.label: RTS fixed-interval smoother
equations.description: Backward pass from k=N-1 to 1, initialized by the filter at N.
equations.justification: Standard RTS recursion for a random walk.

equations.label: Minimax robust design
equations.description: Pick design q_r by grid search over q_d and q using simulated trajectories; the result is typically an inflated q.
equations.abstract_quote: robust fixed-interval smoother designed with uncertainties explicitly introduced in parameters underlying the phase noise
equations.justification: Minimax criterion is the assumed meaning of robust; the paper's exact design may differ (e.g. H-infinity).
assumptions: Minimax over interval is the robustness definition

registers.name: fock
registers.role: truncated Fock register for the squeezed mode, little-endian n

registers.name: c
registers.role: classical bits for measured outcome y (bit i from qubit i)

specification.initial_state: |000> on fock; prepare normalized sum_n c_n|n> using a RY ladder plus controlled RYs (standard gates, no initialize)

steps.description: Simulate or choose the hidden phase trajectory phi_k from the random walk with true q in the interval.
For each k build the circuit: state prep, P-gate phase shift with phi_k, H on all Fock qubits, measure all 3 qubits; collect counts.
Convert counts to y_k by ML over a phi grid and calibrate r.
Run forward filter then RTS smoother with q_r.
Choose q_r by minimax MSE, compare robust smoother, nominal smoother and filter under mismatched q.

specification.measurement: Measure all 3 Fock qubits in the computational basis after H on each; many shots per time step.
specification.classical_postprocessing: ML phase estimate per step, Kalman filter, RTS smoother, minimax selection of q_r, MSE comparison versus true phi.
assumptions: Chosen smallest construction: 3-qubit Fock register, N about 5 steps
Phase is directly observed with Gaussian noise of variance r
Phase must lie in an unambiguous range, with possible 2π-periodic ambiguity ignored
No black-box placeholder used; phase is applied by explicit P gates
missing_information: Paper's actual robust smoother equations and uncertainty model
Continuous-time dynamics and real homodyne model
Query budget and which gate is the hidden box
